title: Enabled-IAST steady-state footprint is ~14 MB live and ~31 MB peak HeapSys over baseline (bounded)
claim: Same woven binary: post-GC HeapAlloc 2.0 MB IAST off vs 16.4 MB on (+14.3 MB, one-time at first sampled request, flat thereafter); peak HeapSys 53 vs 84.5 MiB; both plateau; within the documented 24 MiB envelope.

title: Soak run corroborates perf-contention-F1: owner-lock contention drops ~0.9% of sampled requests while permits are free

title: No lifecycle soak or leak regression exists in the repository
